newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals seen opening mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals seen opening mixed.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals were called to open mixed Friday, as gold tested key resistance at $325.00 an ounce overnight, providing some support to the rest of the complex.
COMEX August gold was called to open unchanged to down 50 cents from Thursday's close at $324.70 an ounce, reflecting fears that resistance around the $325.00 will hold.
In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted $322.75/25 early, compared to the London Friday morning fix at $323.45 and the New York close Thursday around $323.50/00.
Gold prices jumped sharply Thursday on fund, trade house and commission house short covering, after gold fell to 12 year lows last week.
COMEX September silver was seen opening unchanged to up 1.0 cent from Thursday's close at $4.245 an ounce, after trading in a $4.250-4.290 range in overnight ACCESS trade.

NYMEX October platinum was seen opening unchanged to down $2.00 an ounce from Thursday's close at $393.70, but NYMEX September palladium was seen opening unchanged to up $2.00 an ounce from the previous close at $160.35 an ounce.
Russian platinum group metals supplies resumed this week, after a suspsension of six months.
